hero.title: Create bold digital experiences
hero.tagline: A powerful, modern content management system built with Laravel and React.

flexible.title: Flexible Content Types
flexible.description: Create custom post types and taxonomies to organize your content exactly how you need it.

multilingual.title: Multi-Language Content
multilingual.description: Translate posts, pages, menus and settings per locale, with a per-language editor.

roles.title: Role-Based Access
roles.description: Granular permissions system to control who can create, edit, and publish content.

themes.title: Themes
themes.description: React components resolved per theme, with a clean default you can restyle or replace.

plugins.title: Plugins & Hooks
plugins.description: Extend anything with WordPress-style hooks. Ships with a contact form and a full shop.

operations.title: Safe Operations
operations.description: Health checks, nightly backups, one-click updates and a queue worker keep the site running.

stack.title: Built on solid technology
stack.description: Modern, boring-in-a-good-way tools — the same stack running some of the busiest sites on the web.

registry.title: A registry full of plugins
registry.description: Shop, contact forms and more install straight from the admin panel — every package checksum-verified before a byte is unpacked.

demo.description: This demo resets regularly and the passwords below are public on purpose. Pick a role and explore.
